decisions.decision: UC2 (Salesforce → ComputerEase, Job) classified CONFIRMED flow.

decisions.decision: UC3 (Documents → IDP → Salesforce validation) classified CONFIRMED flow.

decisions.decision: UC4 (Salesforce → HD Portal exception write-back) classified CONFIRMED flow.

decisions.decision: UC6-potential (SF → CE, subcontract / commission worksheet) classified POTENTIAL flow.

decisions.decision: UC7-potential (CE → SF, job status / close-loop) classified POTENTIAL flow.
